generatedFor: WO-023 — Triage ui/lib/core/ files into migration effort buckets (blocks WO-034)

methodology.scope: Every .js file under ui/lib/core/ (260 files: 102 in addon/, 157 in app/, 1 addon index.js). ui/lib/core/**/*.ts (56 files) and ui/lib/core/**/*.hbs (119 files) are excluded from the entries below because they are already TypeScript / are templates with no migration classification of their own, per the WO-023 scope.
methodology.patternDetection: Regex-based static analysis of each file's default/named export declarations: Mixin.create( -> mixin; `X.extend(` -> classic-extend; `export default class` -> octane-class (bumped to medium if it still calls legacy computed()/observer() internally); `helper(...)`/`buildHelper(...)` default export -> helper; plain `export function`/`export default function`/object-literal export -> utility. Every classification below was cross-checked by reading the actual file (see AC-2/AC-3 spot-check evidence in the WO comment).
methodology.dependencyGraph: Built by parsing `import ... from '...'` and `export { ... } from '...'` specifiers in every .js AND .ts file under ui/lib/core/, resolving relative imports and `core/...` absolute imports (per ui/tsconfig.json paths mapping "core/*" -> "lib/core/addon/*") to real files in this directory, and counting unique resolving source files per target. This intentionally matches the AC's literal definition ("number of other core files that import this file") — it does NOT count usages from ui/app/**, other engine libs (lib/pki, lib/kv, etc.), or .hbs template invocations (e.g. <SomeComponent /> or {{some-helper}}), since those are outside "core files" and outside static import-statement parsing per the implementation_steps. Because of that, widely-used UI components/helpers invoked only from .hbs templates in *other* libs can correctly show dependencyCount 0 here while still being heavily used app-wide; wave assignment in this artifact reflects intra-core coupling only, as specified.
methodology.waveAssignment: wave 1: dependencyCount >= 5 (intra-core foundations, convert first). wave 2: dependencyCount 1-4. wave 3: dependencyCount === 0 (leaf nodes, convert last) — per AC-4.
